customers.evidence: The people we serve are at the heart of everything we do.

employees.evidence: Our associates have deep home improvement experience and training

shareholders.evidence: build a sustainable foundation for growth

result.analyst_notes: Customer-first, aspirational framing opens the page with the people served and a 'we designed our business' reassurance. Voice is first-person plural with largely absolute claims. Headline figures (sales, associates, customers, community investment) are presented as factual scale rather than commitments. Workforce, environment, DEI and integrity are essentially absent.
